title: The Ref Who Fixed a Rugby Match by Shortening the First Half
hook: A referee adjusted his watch mid-game, shaving off 12 minutes — the team that needed time to catch up never had a chance.
why_this_can_go_viral: Time manipulation is a universally understood betrayal — viewers will rewatch to catch the trick.

title: The Psychologist Who Made a Golfer Flinch on Every Putt Using Subliminal Snake Images
hook: A single frame of a snake hidden in the tournament program — and the golfer flinched on every putt for a year.
why_this_can_go_viral: The subtlety of a single hidden frame causing visible physical flinching is mind-blowing — viewers will want to test it.
